subject: Air-gapped update: signer succession, courier windows & go/no-go calendar
messages:
From: Ops Team (Acme Energy) <ops@acme-energy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Planned air-gapped update: target 2026-11-22 - signer succession question

Hi Kimberly,

We're planning a maintenance window for our air-gapped production cluster the week of Nov 22. The patch bundle and image manifest will arrive via courier (likely IronGate) and our operator team will perform the install from a locked jump host.

Before we lock dates, we need a clear signer succession (who can endorse the manifest if primary signer is unavailable), the proposed pick-up/drop windows for the courier, and a short go/no-go calendar so our SOC/audit team can align. Can Redwood provide the signer roster, a recommended 2-hour acceptance window, and an emergency rollback contact chain?

ACME notes: minimal on-site staff on 11/22 (single-shift day team), SOC will want evidence of signature verification and a manifest checksum prior to activation.

Thanks,
Aaron Patel
Ops Lead — Acme Energy
ops@acme-energy.com

Attachments: none included in this mail

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team (Acme Energy) <ops@acme-energy.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Planned air-gapped update: target 2026-11-22 - signer succession question

Aaron — thanks for the heads up. We can support Nov 22; below is a concise plan and what we'll need from ACME before acceptance.

1) Signer succession
   - Primary: acme-signer-1 (onsite HSM)
   - Secondary (Redwood escrowed): kimberly.park@redwood.com (on-call), ben.carter@redwood.com (backup)
   - Tertiary: marissa.cole@redwood.com (emergency only)

2) Proposed courier windows (Redwood recommended):
   - Pickup at Redwood depot: 11/21 17:00–19:00 PT
   - Delivery to ACME facility: 11/22 08:00–10:00 local
   - Acceptance window (ACME operator verifies, signs manifest): 11/22 10:00–12:00 local (2-hour target)

3) Evidence we will provide pre-activation:
   - Signed manifest (PKCS7) + signer roster CSV
   - SHA256 checksums for each artifact inside manifest_v2.tar.gz
   - Timestamped acceptance log exported to Drive link and included in DocuSign envelope for audit

4) Emergency rollback chain:
   - Primary ops on-call (ACME): aaron.patel@acme-energy.com
   - Redwood emergency: kimberly.park@redwood.com -> ben.carter@redwood.com -> marissa.cole@redwood.com

I've attached a signer roster draft and the manifest package we plan to ship (manifest_v2.tar.gz). Please confirm courier preference (IronGate is fine), and whether the 10:00–12:00 acceptance window works given your single-shift constraint. If you want a later window we'll shift courier arrival but that affects depot cutover.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: signer_roster_20261115.csv (csv), manifest_v2.tar.gz (tar.gz)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: ACME airgap — confirm signer succession & operator checklist

Folks — looping you in to finalize the plan for ACME's Nov 22 activity. Key asks from ACME: strict 2-hour acceptance window, signed manifest verification before activation, and a clean rollback path.

Questions for you:
- Ben: can IronGate do a morning delivery (08:00–10:00)? If not, what's the latest depot cut we can accept for same-day delivery?
- Marissa: can you confirm the op_acceptance_checklist_v3.pdf has everything ACME needs for their SOC request (manifest verification steps, offline checksum verification commands, operator acceptance signature template)?
- Karthik: if primary signer is unreachable during acceptance, what's the minimum escalation time to get Redwood secondary signatures (we should timebox to 30 minutes)?

I attached the draft acceptance checklist and updated signer roster. Please respond with exact times we should tell ACME and any edits to the roster. We prefer to keep Redwood signing to two people maximum during normal flows to minimize complexity.

Thanks,
Kim

Attachments: signer_roster_20261115.csv, op_acceptance_checklist_v3.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME airgap — confirm signer succession & operator checklist

Kim — IronGate confirmed a morning slot: pickup 11/21 18:00 PT, local delivery 11/22 between 07:45–09:30 depending on traffic. That maps well to your acceptance window if we ask ACME to target 10:00–12:00.

Depot cut for same-day delivery is 18:00 on 11/21. If they miss that, earliest delivery shifts to 11/23 — callout for ACME ops.

On signer escalation timing: Karthik and I will accept Redwood secondary signing within 20–30 minutes. Proposed escalation script:
 - At t0 (manifest presented), ACME verifies checksums locally.
 - If primary signer unavailable at t0+10m, Ben triggers Redwood secondary via secure HSM channel (we have an operator phone-based out-of-band confirmation step).
 - If no confirmation by t0+30m, pause activation and log a go/no-go.

Marissa — quick review of checklist: good to merge one addition: a short operator troubleshooting substep for HSM token access failures (we should include fallback to manual hash verification and timestamped DocuSign acknowledgement).

I'll confirm courier PoD and routing and attach the IronGate manifest once they send it.

Ben
Senior Deployment Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none in this mail (IronGate manifest pending)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ops Team (Acme Energy) <ops@acme-energy.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Final schedule & acceptance instructions — ACME air-gapped update (Nov 22)

Aaron / ACME ops — finalizing the calendar and acceptance checklist below. Thanks for confirming IronGate; Ben confirmed depot cut and delivery window. Please review and confirm by EOD 11/18.

Final schedule (all times local to ACME facility):
 - 11/21 18:00 PT: Redwood depot cut (IronGate pickup)
 - 11/22 07:45–09:30: IronGate delivery window (courier may arrive earlier, ACME operator should be ready to sign)
 - 11/22 10:00–12:00: Acceptance window (2 hours) — ACME performs checksum verification, signs manifest. Redwood secondary signer on-call if needed.
 - 11/22 12:00–12:30: Final go/no-go conference call (ACME ops + Redwood on-call)

Acceptance instructions (short):
 1) Verify SHA256 checksums in manifest_v2.tar.gz against local extraction (commands provided in op_acceptance_checklist_v3.pdf).
 2) Confirm PKCS7 signature verifies against signer_roster_20261115.csv.
 3) If primary signer HSM not reachable, escalate to Redwood secondary via secure channel (Ben/Kim) and record timestamped approval in acceptance log.
 4) If secondary cannot be reached within 30 minutes, DO NOT ACTIVATE — perform a safe rollback to pre-accept state and sign the acceptance log as "deferred".

Attached: op_acceptance_checklist_v3.pdf, signer_roster_20261115.csv.

We will prepare the DocuSign envelope and the Drive folder for evidence export immediately after acceptance. Please reply with a single-line confirmation: "ACME accepted → Nov 22 10:00–12:00 window OK" or suggest an alternate 2-hour window.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Deployments — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: op_acceptance_checklist_v3.pdf, signer_roster_20261115.csv
